content: Slack incoming webhooks (api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks, fetched 2026-08): POST JSON to per-app-per-channel secret URL hooks.slack.com/services/... Payload: text, blocks (Block Kit), attachments, thread_ts (threaded reply; ts not returned by webhook, must fetch separately). Formatting is mrkdwn (*bold*, _italic_) not standard markdown. Interactive components (buttons) can be included in blocks but clicks are delivered to the parent Slack app Interactivity Request URL - incoming webhook URL alone receives nothing; cannot delete messages posted via incoming webhook (chat.postMessage needed); cannot override channel/username/icon. Errors: descriptive codes (invalid_token, no_text, too_many_attachments>100).
